identity.role_confidence: assumed: the key art is a spike load and the featured event is titled 追風扣殺手 (roughly 'wind-chasing spike ace'). Confirm with the design owner.
identity.one_line: The calm ace: stillness while she aims, one decisive release.
pillars: The aim-and-load reach: left hand fully extended with fingers spread wide, right hand cocked behind the head.
High ponytail tied with a thin sky-blue ribbon whose loop stands upright above the head and whose tail streams.
Cool, heavy-lidded teal eyes, level brows angled toward the nose, lips parted in a controlled exhale. She does not smile while playing.
Asymmetric legwear: a black knee-high sock on the LEFT leg only, a low light ankle sock on the right. Knee pads on both knees.
#2 uniform: teal-to-pale gradient front with a wind-swirl print, white side panels, royal-blue piping, navy gradient shorts.

Ponytail mass that sweeps opposite the reach (long, thick at the root, three tapering sub-masses)
Split bang points reaching the eyes; long cheek lock curling under the jaw on her left
Spread-finger reaching hand (each finger separable in silhouette)
Loose jersey hem flaring over short fitted shorts

proportions.note: Blocking targets for the rig builder and the body blockout. The key art is a foreshortened low-angle leap, so these are ESTIMATES until checked against a turnaround. Confidence is listed per value.

confidence.head_units: medium: V09 proportion master: ~7.3 heads including hair (8.3 read as a small head on a realistic body). Previously: 7.9 heads including hair volume (art-direction pass: 8.9 read as a small, generic head). The design owner asked for a vertically compressed face (eye-to-chin ~1.3x the eye spacing, as in the in-game close-up); the small head also suits her long-legged key art.
confidence.leg_ratio: medium-high: proportion pass. Long legs are her defining line; hip joint at 57% of height (realistic ~52%). The torso gets shorter as the legs get longer, so she reads taller without being taller.
confidence.shoulder_width: medium (athletic but narrow compared to the thigh mass)

body_notes: Slender, long-limbed, lightweight anime volleyball athlete: the silhouette is long lines, not muscle volume.
Long legs with slim thighs (clean taper to a small knee), slender calves and narrow ankles; small feet.
Narrow torso and shoulders, a full chest as in the 2D art (design owner: it is not small or flat), clean waist without an exaggerated hourglass; full thighs.
Long slim arms tapering to narrow wrists; slender hands with long fingers. The hand is a hero element of her pose.

body_shape.note: Volume multipliers on the body master's reference body (1.0 = realistic athletic 1.66 m woman; ranges in pipeline/specs/body.json). Sara: slender, long-limbed, lightweight anime volleyball athlete; athleticism from length, posture and motion, not muscle volume. Moderately narrow, delicate shoulders; slender torso with a gradual rib-to-waist-to-pelvis transition (never pinched, never an hourglass); one coherent pelvis volume (depth follows width); slim but athletic thighs; small, structurally readable knees; slim calves with a controlled taper; ankles clearly narrower than the calves; segmented arms (deltoid, elbow, forearm belly, wrist); compact feet with an arch. Proportion-pass feedback: not thinner, better distributed.

head_shape.note: Multipliers on the head master's reference anime head (pipeline/blender/spike_pipeline/modeling/head_master.py; ranges in pipeline/specs/body.json). Sara (front reference sara_standing_front34.png): slender soft oval, a gently convex jaw line into a small, softly pointed chin (never a straight V, never round jowls), subtle midface cheek volume, a small nose with a real bridge and tip that reads in 3/4, a small mouth with lip volume set into the lower face, a round cranium.

palette.note: Sampled from the key art (297x673 JPEG) and the 1918x820 cut-in video frame, then corrected for compression and lighting. Iris colors follow the in-game close-up (reference video 0.0-2.8 s), which the design owner chose as the eye quality target. Re-sample from the original source art when it is available.

design_notes: Acorn-shaped face: round, wide skull and cheeks tapering quickly to a small pointed chin. Eye line to chin is ~1.1x the distance between the eye centers (in-game close-up); mouth small and close to the chin.
Eye line at ~47% of head height from the chin. Eyes are large; the default upper lid rests slightly on the iris and lowers further in her focus expressions (lid_heavy).
Upper lash line thick with a slight outer wing; lower lash line thin and broken.
Brows thin and straight, angled down toward the nose when focused.
Nose: minimal bridge, small tip with a pink blush highlight (visible in the key art).
Mouth: small. Default is a parted exhale, not a closed line.

primary: side locks (left curls under jaw, right longer)
secondary: 3 ponytail sub-masses that fan when moving
ahoge (2 fine strands at the crown)
tertiary: 6-10 flyaway strands at the temples and ponytail (LOD0 only) that cross the face in close-ups
construction.ribbon: Thin satin ribbon (~12 mm wide) over a navy elastic tie. One standing loop (~11 cm) and one long tail (~27 cm).

hair.highlight: Broken angel ring following the crown curve, warm grey, never a continuous band. Ends lighten toward a cool cream rim.

secondary_chains.note: Chains the rig builder creates and the Godot SpringBoneSimulator3D simulates. root/direction are normalized to height in Blender space (Z up, character faces -Y, +X = her left). length is a fraction of height. Spring values are SpringBoneSimulator3D settings.

clothing.notes: Sleeveless cap-shoulder cut, deep armholes. Front panel teal gradient (dark at chest to pale at hem) with the wind-swirl print and a large '2'. White side panels from armpit to hem with royal-blue piping on the seam. Straight hem, untucked, 5-8 cm over the shorts. Real thickness (2-3 mm) at the neckline, armholes and hem. Sports mesh: matte, fine weave only in close-up.

Fitted volleyball shorts, navy with a lighter lower-side gradient. Pale-blue curved side panel with royal-blue piping; small '2' on the right-leg panel. Short inseam. Leg openings compress the thigh slightly (sculpted skin bulge).

Sara's knee protection (key art): THIN knee sleeves on both knees, ~3 mm off the leg, conforming to the knee with a flat low front plate over the patella; white body, slim sky-blue elastic bands at the top and bottom edges. Not foam volleyball pads. Front plate stays rigid, back sleeve compresses (corr_kneepad_*).
LEFT: black compression knee-high ending under the knee pad, satin-matte knit with a cool sheen. RIGHT: light ankle sock showing above the shoe.

Low-mid volleyball shoes. Light grey mesh upper, black side panel stripe, black heel counter and outsole edge, black criss-cross laces, white midsole, light grey tongue. Designed as an object with separate upper / midsole / outsole / tongue / laces / heel counter.
Sky-blue satin ribbon over a navy elastic tie. Loop stands, tail streams.

personality.summary: Stillness, then decision. Sara wastes no motion. Her anticipation is longer and quieter than the roster average; her release is sharper. She tracks the ball with her eyes before her head moves.

movement_notes.idle: Weight on one leg, still. Occasional adjustment of the ribbon tail with the right hand; a slow blink.
movement_notes.ready_stance: Low and quiet, small bounces, the eyes do the searching.
movement_notes.approach: Long gliding strides. Both arms swing far back on the penultimate step.
movement_notes.spike: Signature reach: the left arm extends fully with spread fingers and HOLDS; the right arm draws back behind the head; then a whip with minimal follow-through flourish.
movement_notes.land: Controlled, quiet. The ponytail keeps travelling after she has stopped.
movement_notes.celebration: Restrained: an exhale with the eyes closed, a small smile, a head turn that swings the ponytail.
movement_notes.victory: Recreates the reach toward the camera, then lowers the hand and looks past it.
movement_notes.defeat: Eyes down, right hand touches the ribbon.

vfx.motif: Wind. Derived from her own design (the swirl print on her jersey, the streaming ponytail and ribbon), not from the reference video. Streaks spiral; they do not rise in straight lines.

sara_wind_gather.desc: Fine air motes drift inward and upward. Background layer only.

sara_dust_takeoff.desc: Court dust at takeoff, tinted by the court, not the accent.

sara_wind_spiral.desc: Two helical streaks rising around her at a radius wider than the shoulders. A gap is kept open in front of the face.

sara_impact_shear.desc: Crescent air-shear along the arm-swing arc, centered on the ball, offset from the face. Two frames at full intensity.

sara_ball_trail.desc: Twisting wind ribbon behind the ball in the accent color.

sara_court_swirl.desc: Landing ring drawn as the jersey's swirl motif.

special.title: Wind Chaser
special.concept: Everything goes still, she aims, and the wind answers. The sequence is built on her rhythm: a long quiet hold, then a snap.

rules.outcome: Decided by gameplay at the trigger. The sequence only presents it.
